# CAMT independent audit v1

Audit cutoff: 18 October 2026. USD millions unless stated. Original package preserved.

## Verdict

**Ready for limited integration as a dated operating EV / editable conditional-claims model.** Exact current equity and per-share values remain unapproved and null. Missing October balances do not block this explicitly June-origin analysis. The $650m convertible placeholder is not an accepted fair-value estimate.

Independent arithmetic/source-linkage checks: **1648/1648 pass**. The script reimplements the DCF without importing or running either source builder. It tests every annual field, terminal calculation, published operating sensitivity, CSV row, 289 historical source facts, all ten printed diluted-share counts, and preserved source hashes.

## Reproduced operating values

| Scenario | EV | Terminal share | Terminal investment | Funding floor | Cushion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| downcycle | 1,216.498 | 51.9% | 42.153 | 35.647 | 6.506 |
| base | 2,917.659 | 60.3% | 63.273 | 51.328 | 11.944 |
| upside | 4,887.490 | 66.2% | 95.475 | 73.387 | 22.087 |

Every annual investment meets its modeled cash-funding floor. Year-10 growth, reinvestment/NOPAT and FCFF reconcile to the terminal regime. Fresh grants remain an operating cost; the legacy display expense cancels before NOPAT. No extra future dilution or duplicate convertible face/share claim is inserted.

## Timing, latest disclosures and capital

- Capital/discount origin is June 30, 2026; cash flows cover July 2026–June 2036 with end-year discounting. October inputs are retrospective information, not an October cash reconstruction.
- October 14 supports preliminary Q3 $160–161m, Q4 about $180m, FY2026 about $595m, and initial FY2027 above $800m. Orders above $800m are YTD intake with 2026–27 deliveries. [SEC update](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109138/000117891326004767/zk2636225.htm)
- The $1.2bn, roughly three-year organic model and 34–36% non-GAAP margin are targets expressly distinguished from guidance. [Investor presentation](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109138/000117891326004769/zk2636226.htm)
- June liquid assets total $815.837m; the 3% operating reserve is $15.27057m. Outstanding common is 48.760553m issued less 2.092376m treasury = 46.668177m. [Interim filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109138/000117891326003975/zk2635905.htm)
- The contract permits cash, stock or combination settlement and changeable initial default; 40-day averaging and adjustment clauses matter. The 4.57275m initial underlying shares cannot be added while also deducting full note fair value. [Indenture section 14](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109138/000117891325003347/exhibit_4-1.htm)

## Conditions and cautions

**Valuation date.** June 30 capital/discount origin with information through October 18, 2026. Ten full years end June 2036, end-year discounting. This is a retrospective-information analytical DCF, not an October 18 equity fair value or point-in-time June thesis.

**Convertible and claims.** 650 full convertible claim, 5.324 finance lease, 25 residual claims, 2 legacy option claim and 0.85m RSUs remain illustrative. No fixed claim is independently certified. Full-note deduction and no extra face/conversion-share addition is arithmetically coherent; common allocation requires contract-aware scenario repricing and same-date claims.

**Old notes and operating-capital claims.** June carrying balance is consistent with only 2030 notes but cannot prove old-note settlement composition. Full interim cash flow, gross awards, leases, opening tax/acquisition/capital payables remain unresolved. This does not block dated operating EV or explicitly editable conditional allocation.

**Historical depreciation.** Annual note/depreciation comparisons and 2023 cash-flow D&A do not fully reconcile; lease ROU is included in annual PPE. Do not convert this history into clean physical D&A or normalized historical ROIC. Forecast depreciation 1.7% is explicit and independent.

**Visual Layer timing.** Replace acquired in April 2026 with acquisition announced April 14 and closed by May 12. No effect on the June-origin bridge; acquisition cash is already embedded.

**Terminal and funding economics.** Terminal values contribute 51.9%/60.3%/66.2% of EV. Years 6–9 blend marginal-sales funding with terminal-growth reinvestment and retain a cash floor; this is an explicit policy, not demonstrated constant historical ROIC. Terminal investment covers the modeled floor and year-10 cash-flow continuity passes.

**Discount inputs.** Monthly ERP, October 16 yield and January sector beta are deliberately mixed-date estimates. Debt weight 5%, Treasury spread 175bp and mature levered beta 1.15 are analyst assumptions. Verified inputs do not make them issuer-observed costs of capital.

**History audit scope.** 289 populated historical facts match frozen SEC companyfacts and scales; all ten diluted share counts match printed statements. This is source linkage and arithmetic testing, not a statutory audit or independent certification of every issuer disclosure. Early continuing CFO and potentially total-business capex remain non-comparable.

## Reproduce and preservation

Run `python independent-audit-v1.py` in this folder. The script writes only this report and its JSON companion. The JSON includes all test results and SHA-256 hashes of original files. Primary web verification is dated; rerunning the script refreshes arithmetic, not source retrieval. No source v1, public-safe package or Site was changed.
